provenance.how: Real live run: python3 ve_regulatory.py --input demo_variants.tsv --output <dir> against a working venv (torch 2.13.0, cherimoya 0.2.0, tangermeme 1.4.1, bpnet-lite 1.0.0, huggingface_hub 1.28.0) on Python 3.13.12, Apple Silicon (arm64), CPU inference (device='cpu', compile=False). Checkpoints and CATv1-metadata.tsv/performance.tsv pulled live from the programmable-genomics/CATv1 Hugging Face Hub repo; hg38 windows pulled live from the Ensembl REST sequence API (rest.ensembl.org).
provenance.not_fabricated: Every number in `records` below is copied verbatim from that run's result.json; none were hand-edited or estimated.

evidence.model_selection: accession supplied by the caller; ve-regulatory cannot verify that a --propose shortlist was produced or reviewed by a human
notes: predicted_accessibility is CATv1's own model output: a continuous score, not a called ATAC/DNase peak; ENCODE peak BEDs were not consulted.

magnitude_uncalibrated is UNCALIBRATED: a published evaluation of this model class found predicted fold-changes fall roughly an order of magnitude below measured ones (rs12740374/SORT1: ~12-fold measured). Treat only direction as informative.
contribution_delta is native tangermeme.saturation_mutagenesis attribution on the log-count head -- the one number here with no interpretive layer added.
tf_binding flags a high-attribution, motif-like position only. CATv1 gives no TF identity; no transcription factor is ever named.
